## What you did
- Configured the production RDS blue/green deployment for PostgreSQL 17, wrote the runbook, rehearsed the switchover with 74 seconds of downtime, and opened PR #321 [1][3].

## What changed
- Maya Cohen approved PR #321 and reported that the cutover window moved to Sunday 22/11 (02:00–04:00 UTC) due to Fernhill's month-end batch run [3][8].
- Lior Ben-David requested a 30-minute notice before switchover to pause ingest workers, and Daniel Levi noted he will be on-call for the API side on Sunday [7][9].

## What is still open
- Update the runbook with the new window, rehearse the rollback on a fresh clone on Thursday, and merge PR #321 [3][8].
